name: Fear-based conditions
rules: Shaken, Frightened and Panicked remain distinct conditions with independently tracked durations; they must not become edition-dependent synonyms.
Native Frightened preserves its approved existing effects and does not automatically compel retreat merely because a third-edition source does.
A Panicked creature drops held items when it first becomes Panicked, must flee from dangerous sources by the fastest viable route, and may use other spells/abilities only to flee.

If a Panicked creature has no viable escape route, it becomes Cowering for as long as the route remains unavailable; this derived Cowering ends when escape becomes possible, leaving independently applied Cowering instances intact.
A -2 fear-family modifier on the same check or save applies at most once, even if Shaken and Panicked effects are present. Other genuinely independent modifiers may still apply.
Cowering suppresses positive Dexterity/dodge AC components and applies -2 AC, not the more severe Helpless Dexterity-as-0 rule. Cowering does not automatically end Concentration.
The historical cumulative fear escalation across independent effects is not automatically enabled. Its behavior and return to weaker states when effects expire require explicit reconciliation.
